verdict.rationale: Jules exposes some autonomy controls: plan approval is required by default before code changes (jules-docs-4), the API `requirePlanApproval` field lets you toggle whether explicit approval is needed (jules-docs-16), and `automationMode` controls whether PRs are auto-created (jules-docs-11), giving a basic two-tier confirm-vs-auto pattern. However, this is configured per-session via API/settings rather than as an engineering-lead-level policy/tiering system across a team, with no evidence of granular permission tiers, org-wide governance, or audit controls. Missing for 10: org/team-level autonomy tiering, multiple granular permission levels beyond plan-approval on/off, admin enforcement across users, and independent confirmation these settings are used for oversight governance.
